mechanics.claim: The bleed refreshes its duration on each new application rather than stacking as a separate instance.
mechanics.quote: inflict a bleed against enemies for {{#var:i_dotd}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications

mechanics.claim: The bleed always heals Briar based on pre-mitigation damage, so it does not heal against damage reduction effects, and does not heal at all against invulnerable targets (no damage is dealt).
mechanics.quote:
The bleed always heals '''Briar''' for {{ap|{{#var:i_heal}}*100}}% of the {{tt|pre-mitigation damage|Damage calculated before modifiers}} dealt.
** Because of this, '''Briar''' will not heal on {{tip|invulnerable}} targets.

mechanics.claim: Blood Frenzy's area-of-effect attack damage around the primary target does not refresh or add bleed stacks.
mechanics.quote: {{ais|Blood Frenzy|Briar}} area of effect damage around the target does not apply bleed stacks.

mechanics.claim: Briar has no base health regeneration, offset by the missing-health healing amplification.
If a bleeding target dies, Briar heals for the remaining (unticked) portion of the bleed's damage.
mechanics.quote: If a target dies while bleeding, she will heal herself equal to 125% <!--pre or post mitigation?--> of the remaining bleed damage.
